QuestInfo.name: Find the Super Idol!
QuestInfo.1: Find the super idol of the battlefield. Make a party with an #bAngelic Buster who is at least Lv. 120#k.\r\n\r\n#r<<To clear this mission you must make a party with a player on the same screen as you.>>#k

yes.0: Today's mission is to find an Angelic Buster, the battleground idol. Actually a strong one, at that. All you have to do is #bmake a party with an Angelic Buster Lv. 120 or higher#k. Good luck!

1.0: Ooh, you found the Battleground Idol! Your membership in the party proves it all. I'll give you a gift!
